name: Makinohara Suzuran
source:
Weakness: Spanking. Gets turned on when being hit in general and not just having her butt spanked.

The pure and innocent student council president whom all the boys in school yearn for.
However, beneath the act, she is slutty girl who treats all the boys of the student council as her pets in her reverse harem. She also meets with various men outside school, sleeping with them for payment.

Since [url=/c42869]Nadeshiko[/url] has returned to school, Suzuran has been losing popularity and in an effort to spite her, she tries to make [url=/c42932]Tsukushi[/url] her pet by seducing him.

"Fufu. How fun. I'm looking forward to... what kind of a face she will  show when she cries, and what she will sound like..."
